messages.subject: Free 2-day lavaan workshop -- limited time!
parts:
Hi everyone
Instats.org is offering access to a 2-day lavaan workshop for anyone who might be interested. The workshop covers path analysis, moderation, mediation, and moderated mediation as well as bootstrapping and Bayesian estimation.

You can find the workshop here < https://instats.org/seminar/path-analysis-with-interactions-and-indi1124 > , as well as the free 2-day seminar for Mplus and Stata here < https://instats.org/seminars_courses?view=ondemand > .

Happy holidays and please share this with your friends and colleagues!

Mike
